e: A student and a janitor are stabbed at a high school in Zagreb.
Croatia participated at the XXth Mediterranean Games in Taranto with 111 sportsmen, winning 39 medals.
A wildfire breaks out near Lokva Rogoznica during the wildfire season and reaches areas near Split and Omiš, killing one person, injuring 43 and displacing around 2,500 others.
Both 37th Men's and 36th Women's European Artistic Gymnastics Championships were held in Arena Zagreb, with 625 gymnasts from 43 countries participating.
The Ministry of Health and the Bosnian-Herzegovinian Federal Ministry of Health sign an "Agreement on cooperation in emergency medicine".
The bodies of three drowned Egyptian nationals are found in the Sava river near Okunšćak.
The 66th Musical Evenings at St Donatus opens at the Roman forum in Zadar with concert of Symphonic orchestra and choir of the Croatian Radiotelevision.

The Croatian youth water polo team wins the gold medal at the World Championship in Portugal; captain Nikola Batoš is named goalkeeper of the tournament, and coach Hrvoje Koljanin coach of the tournament.

The Croatian U16 national field hockey team wins the bronze medal at the EuroHockey U16 5s Championship in Turkey; Leon Hercigonja is named as the MVP of the tournament, and Patrik Horvat as the best goalkeeper of the championship.
The Croatian women's youth handball team wins the bronze medal at the Open European Championship in Sweden.
A drowns in Jarun lake in Zagreb.
A ceremonial parade in Velika Gorica, with more than 300 firefighters from 40 volunteer fire departments, held on the occasion of the 150th anniversary of the Velika Gorica Voluntary Fire Department.
A boy drowns in the Drava between Pušćine and Gornji Hrašćan.
A natural disaster is declared in Štrigova due to a hailstorm.
A light aircraft that originated from Austria crashes near Medulin, killing four people.
The remains of 36 people (35 men and one woman) killed after World War II are buried in Možđenec, Novi Marof.
Croatia wins eight medals at the European Karate Championships in Frankfurt.
European Sailing Championship in ILCA 6 and ILCA 7 in Kaštela.

The Directorate for War Veterans and Military Heritage of Slovenia repatriates in the Dobrava Memorial Park near Maribor the remains of around 500 Croatian victims of World War II and the post-war period, men aged 18 to 40, exhumed from 2013 to 2017 from five locations in Slovenia (Košnica pri Celju, Trebče, Podstenice/Rugarski klanc and Cerklje ob Krki).
A memorial for 15 children killed in the Siege of Dubrovnik is opened in Gruž.

Coptic Pope Tawadros II makes an official visit to Croatia; holding services in Zagreb at the "Day of Coptic-Catholic friendship" and meeting with foreign minister Gordan Grlić-Radman, prime minister Andrej Plenković and speaker of parliament Gordan Jandroković, as well as with president Zoran Milanović. He also meets with Croatian Catholic prelates archbishop Dražen Kutleša, bishop Vjekoslav Huzjak and others.
A magnitude 4.1 earthquake hits near Kopački rit.
Around 12,000 young Catholics from Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina and the Croatian diaspora participate at the 13th Croatian Catholic Youth Meeting in Požega organized by the Diocese of Požega.
International Democracy Union's Forum with 250 party representatives from around 50 countries is held in Zagreb.
Three Seas Initiative's 11th Summit in Dubrovnik, with 1,600 state, financial and corporative representatives from 45 countries participating.
Croatia and Bosnia-Herzegovina sign an agreement to build the Southern Interconnection gas pipeline connecting Bosnia with the LNG terminal in Krk.
A mass grave with the remains of more than 50 victims from World War II and the post-war period is found in the Golubinka cave on Sopanj hill, in Šibenik-Knin County.

At the "Depth Quest" competition in Mabini, Philippines, Croatian freediver Petar Klovar sets two world records (FIM and CWTB), Vitomir Maričić wins first place overall, Sanda Delija sets a national record (CWTB), and Toma Čelar wins the award for the greatest improvement.
Boxer Gabrijel Veočić wins a silver medal at the World Cup in Brazil.
A foreign national is found dead in Staro Selo Topusko.
One person dies in an explosion at an underpass in Split.
Judoka Iva Oberan wins a bronze medal at the European Championship in Tbilisi.
A wildfire breaks out in the protected ornithological reserve Orepak near Vid in the Neretva valley.
Split Open, international wheelchair tennis tournament, in Firule Tennis Centre in Split.
Taekwondoka Klara Uglešić wins a silver medal at the World Junior Championship.
The Croatian women's handball team qualifies for the European Championship in December.
An informal meeting of foreign ministers of the EU MED9 member states in Split.
Gymnastic DOBRO World Cup 2026 in Gradski vrt Hall in Osijek, with gymnasts from 51 countries.
